messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "woodlouse"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large four-legged creature shown in side view facing right, with the shaggy brown fur, broad head, rounded furry ears, muzzle with black nose, and heavy clawed paws of a brown bear, but the back, shoulders, sides, belly and legs are covered by a glossy dark reddish-brown segmented exoskeleton of overlapping plates with a pale ribbed underside bearing rows of oval openings, ending in a small narrow tapering segmented tail at the rear.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "bear", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body, facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head, small rounded and furry"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in back supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs, broad furry paws with long claws"}, {"looks_like": "woodlouse", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear end of the body, short narrow segmented and tapering downward"}, {"looks_like": "woodlouse", "part": "plates", "where": "covering the back, shoulders, sides, belly and upper legs as glossy dark red-brown overlapping segments with a pale segmented underside"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the head, neck, and exposed parts of the legs and body beneath the plates"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
